name: TRUALT BIOENERGY LIMITED
summary: TruAlt Bioenergy Limited produces and sells biofuels in India. Its products include ethanol, compressed biogas, extra neutral alcohol, and fermented organic manure. The company was formerly known as TruAlt Energy Limited and changed its name to TruAlt Bioenergy Limited in July 2022. TruAlt Bioenergy Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
